column1: Autopilot Ahmedabad: Vendor Onboarding enterprise export
System of origin: SAP S/4HANA Business Partner (vendor master extract), supplier registration queue, vendor onboarding mailbox vendor.onboarding@ashvakagroup.in
Organisation: Ashvaka Industries Group (fictional). Currency INR. Timezone IST (UTC+05:30).
Sheets: Onboarding_Requests, Document_Requirements, Verification_Rules, Vendor_Master_Extract, Onboarding_Chase_Log, Received_Documents, Field_Dictionary

Folders: documents/ (one folder per request holding every attachment received so far, as the vendor named it); mailbox/inbox/ (emails received in vendor.onboarding@ashvakagroup.in up to the as-of time (.eml)); mailbox/staged_replies/ (vendor replies that arrive only after the desk sends the matching chase or request); mailbox/mailbox_index.csv (one row per message; release_when says what releases each staged reply); reference/ (Verification_Rule_Set.md and .pdf (rules, chase cadence, holiday calendar, contacts))
Treat 09 Oct 2026, 18:00 IST as the current time, and keep the business date as a setting in your build.
Send outbound mail only to mailboxes you control. Every address in this pack is fictional.
Staged replies are released by your team when the condition in mailbox_index.csv is met, by hand or with a simple automation, and should be shown in the demo.
Company codes: AI10 Ashvaka Infrastructure Limited; AC20 Ashvaka Cement and Building Materials Limited; AE30 Ashvaka Energy Limited; AL40 Ashvaka Logistics and Warehousing Limited

Plants: 1001 Ahmedabad Head Office (AI10); 1002 Sanand Industrial Park Project (AI10); 1003 Dahej Terminal Expansion Project (AI10); 1004 Vadodara Ring Road Package 3 (AI10); 2001 Vadodara Grinding Unit (AC20); 2002 Rajkot RMC Plant (AC20); 3001 Bhuj Solar Park Phase 2 (AE30); 4001 Bhiwandi Distribution Centre (AL40)
Working days are Monday to Friday excluding the group holidays listed in the rule set.
Fully synthetic. No real company, person, account or identifier.
Import into your own systems of record, document store and mail channel, then work through them.
Google integrations are in beta for this event: do not use Google Drive, Sheets or Gmail for this data.
